title: Brooklynn Skye releases her second new single "Be Here"
htmlContent:
Brooklynn Skye is a singer, songwriter and music producer from Chicago. She recently releases her second new single called "Be Here", a follow-up of her latest single "Take You There". She is definitely one of the most talented artist from Chicago paving way in the music industry. That high level of skill that bursts out the seams of the speakers, that leave you in awe and amazement, as you bare witness to something that is truly beyond words. That mega level of talent is what you get from Brooklynn Skye on his new song “Be Here”.

Brooklynn Skye's "Be Here" is a song that shows a high understanding of using the power of good to make the world a better place. They bring a strong sound that stops you in your tracks, and take full advantage of having our ear, to give us a powerful message, that gives us that more that we will forever seek in music.
